status: EXERCISED public-host metric analysis; independent replay/judging NOT_RUN by this agent

provenance.scope: public recorded native host campaign only; no hidden material, producer replay, independent judging, GPU, live service, downloads, deployment or merge
provenance.oracle_identity: public-author metrics oracle; separate Wolfram computation does not make this an independent judge
provenance.platform: host-only AArch64 Linux; source producer recorded by parent on DGX Spark; no device execution evidence

contexts.sender: all four lowbit-first binary evidence bits and shared task; no receiver-private data
contexts.receiver: task, actual carrier bytes, frozen decoder checkpoint; task2 additionally original id&3 supplied by environment, never full id
contexts.scorer: reference input and hidden split; not a receiver input

configuration.learning: three task-specific four-coordinate continuous softsign models; exact masked gradient; no discrete optimizer or straight-through gradient; one checkpoint per task/seed/split shared by dense and factorized inference channels
configuration.selection: none; every arm, seed, split and failure retained; no tuning
configuration.timing: T captures native monotonic timestamps immediately before ninit and after ttrain, initialization plus training only. R captures encode/decode separately. Whole-process and independent verification timing separately recorded; no network or GPU measurement.
configuration.payload: fixed, dense, factorized: actual1byte; fulltext: actual4ASCIIbytes; receiver-only/omitted: actual0bytes; unused32-column CSV padding is logging only, never wire cost
configuration.metadata: no invented transport header; C/P/config/CSV serialization bytes charged separately. Existing NL4 envelope1024header+32payload charged separately at proposal boundary. Model checkpoint40IEEEbinary64 values, persisted header/layout charged by actual artifact length.
configuration.codebooks: algorithmic graph colorings, no separately transmitted dictionary; source/binary/config sizes still charged
configuration.retries: zero inference retries under frozen stop/refusal rule; failed compiler development attempts preserved separately, not hidden in final campaign
configuration.authority: pure typed proposal only, effect0. Existing NL4 independent identity-chunk verification; production capabilities/reservations/authorized execution NOT_RUN

task.1: parity of four bits in coordinate0; canonical inactive coordinates1..3=0
task.2: complete reconstruction with environmental original id&3 known at receiver; only coordinates2,3 active

arm.1: learned dense four two-bit coordinate bins

variant.1: fixed derangement sender sample (id+1)&15; task2 retains original context
variant.2: omitted payload, including receiver-only; required refusal

split.fullfit: mask65535; all sixteen are fit, no heldout set
split.all: all sixteen once; not additive with its fit and heldout subsets

definitions.exact_ignoring_abstention: equality of all four canonical task prediction coordinates and target, regardless of status/abstention; refused zero records can incidentally match the all-zero target, never treated as accepted
definitions.wrong_accepted: accepted and not exact canonical target
definitions.active_feature_errors: Hamming errors only over task active coordinates: task0 all4, task1 coordinate0, task2 coordinates2/3
definitions.forced_decision_01_regret: 0/1 loss of emitted canonical prediction against perfect target, even when abstained/refused; diagnostic forced-decision score, not executed action loss
definitions.accepted_decision_01_regret: wrong_accepted summed; mean conditional on accepted records, null if none; perfect-reference decision loss0
definitions.abstention_regret: null because no abstention penalty was specified; do not combine with accepted loss
definitions.exact_rate_and_means: exact rational strings computed by Wolfram, not rounded decimals
definitions.failure_reporting: all seeds, arms, variants and splits retained; process exit0 is execution success, not task success; no best-seed selection
definitions.timings: monotonic wall intervals in nanoseconds, not process CPU time; producer encode/decode measurements and launcher whole-process timestamps only
definitions.no_double_counting: campaign aggregates use fullfit or all, never all+fit+heldout; per-run files deliberately expose these overlapping views
